package_changes: Leaflet 1.9.4 vendored with its licence and precached

Local server binds to loopback by default
Old static-only instructions replaced
Session-based NOTAM coverage and per-sortie change review
Manual flight lifecycle and post-flight debrief
Versioned AGPL source offer, origin and branding notices
Reusable setup profiles, draft recovery and protected local backups
Complete 1.0.2 source upload manifest, early API consistency checks and Cloudflare fingerprint fix
Explicit stable flight identities, grouped phase records, resume/new workflow, debrief draft recovery and complete-flight export/import
Local recovery/action feedback; paired visible forecast/observation layouts; sourced precipitation references and 3km NOTAM default; reordered field preparation
Structured completion independent from suitability, traffic-light recommendations, source-linked final statuses, visible radar, timestamped inspection history and reviewed-forecast identity
NOTAM collection and search outcomes, manual review completion distinct from suitability, clickable final airspace acknowledgement
Weather reordered limits/forecast maps radar/observations/decisions, with final acknowledgement last
